verdict.rationale: Pulley explicitly markets ASC 718 reporting as part of its compliance product, alongside tax filings and board management, indicating built-in stock-based compensation expense reporting. However, there is no evidence detailing report format, auditor-readiness specifics, or independent/hands-on confirmation that accountants can directly hand these reports to auditors. Missing for 10: sample ASC 718 report output, auditor/accountant corroboration, detail on methodology (e.g., valuation inputs, expense recognition schedules).
